title: Banking change line
description: Ledger-specific checks for any change that touches cash accounts, account balances, balance transfers or platforms (banks/brokers). Triggered automatically by factory-line-router (verify --full) when a diff enters the territory in triggers.json; S3 must be green for the exact tree before the work is done.

stations.title: Ledger contract
stations.description: Static: banking route policy (guards, permission, scope, impersonation, redaction), Prisma ledger invariants, migration safety (applied migrations immutable, no silent destruction of banking data). Exceptions go to ledger-acks.json.

stations.title: Unit-prove the banking territory
stations.description: Every spec in the banking territory (account helper, cash calculators, balance-date validator, …) passes and banking source changes ship with a spec change.

stations.title: Prove the ledger live
stations.description: Live on the slot API with throwaway accounts: exact money conservation on transfers, rejection of invalid transfers with untouched balances, one balance per day, cross-user isolation (IDOR), cascade on account deletion.

extraStages.description: banking-change S1: route policy, ledger schema invariants, migration safety
banking-change S3: live ledger proofs on the slot API

handoff.waitFor: human review of the ledger report and any new ledger-acks.json entry before merge

traveler.note: Paste the gate summary (har line status banking-change) into the PR; .har/runs is local evidence.

prototypeNotes: Territory is declared in triggers.json (paths, Prisma models, specs) — a repo-local extension read by factory-line-router, not part of the line contract.
Stages import .har/stages/lib/factory-line.mjs, shipped by the factory-line-router plugin (declared in plugins[]).
banking-e2e stays in one currency: slots have no exchange-rate data (cron disabled), so cross-currency transfers fall back to 1:1 and conservation cannot be asserted there.
